shooting (Gisborne Jnl 128 n. 87), and Livorno was a centre for the trade in the red coral to be
found in the Mediterranean nearby (Claire Jnl 160 and Galignani’s Traveller’s Guide through

communicated to Jane Williams between January and May 1822, the period during which S.
wrote six substantial lyrics for her: To —— ‘The serpent is shut out from Paradise’; To Jane. The
